fm2.name: FM2 - Flammability of Materials on the Moon
fm2.note: Studies how materials burn at 1/6 g. Will test 21% O2 at 14.7 psia and 34% at 8.2 psia.

luci.name: LUCI - Lunar Combustion Investigation
luci.note: Suborbital rocket that simulates lunar gravity and measures flame spread.

sofie.name: SoFIE - Solid Fuel Ignition and Extinction
sofie.note: Tests the 1 g flammability standard in microgravity.

flare.name: FLARE - Flammability Limits at Reduced-g
flare.note: Seeks to relate 1 g flammability limits to low-gravity ones.

saffire.name: Saffire - Large-Scale Spacecraft Fires
saffire.note: Fires of up to ~10 kW in uncrewed spacecraft.

cir.name: CIR - Combustion Integrated Rack (ISS)
cir.note: ISS combustion rack with a 100 L chamber.
